info.title: OTel AI Cost Local Serve API
info.description: Local OSS cost report HTTP snapshot (Node stdlib `http`; hosted dashboard = paid later). Documents `GET /health`, `GET /ready`, `GET /` (HTML+SVG), `GET /report.json`, `GET /v1/costs.csv`, `GET /v1/costs.md`, `GET /v1/costs.gha.txt`, `GET /v1/costs?format=csv|json|md|gha`, `GET /openapi.json`, `GET /metrics` (Prometheus text: `otel_ai_cost_total_usd`, `otel_ai_cost_by_model_usd{model}`, `otel_ai_cost_span_count`). `GET /ready` is **200** `{ok:true, service}` plus the same snapshot fields as `/health` when healthy (stateless; no circuit/queue). On SIGTERM/SIGINT, **503** `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` (liveness `GET /health` stays 200 with `shuttingDown: true` while draining). Compose/stack-demo healthchecks stay on `/health`. `GET /openapi.json` serves this file. Report is computed once at process start. Optional `X-Request-Id` request header: echoed on **every** response (including 4xx / OPTIONS). If omitted or empty, the server generates a UUID (max 128 chars; CR/LF stripped). Default allow/expose CORS headers include `X-Request-Id`. **403 CORS**: optional `--cors-origins` CSV or env `OTEL_AI_COST_CORS_ORIGINS` (`*` allowed). Default omitted/empty = no extra CORS headers (deny; OPTIONS **404**). When enabled with an explicit list, OPTIONS preflight for a listed Origin → **204** with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` / `Allow-Methods` / `Allow-Headers`; unlisted Origin (e.g. `http://evil.example`) → **403** `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}` (no ACAO). Matching GET includes ACAO. GET from a disallowed Origin still executes (e.g. 200) but omits ACAO. local-mvp isolated prove uses `http://localhost:3000`; main serve / stack-demo default deny. **429 rate limit**: `--rate-limit` / env `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` (alias `RATE_LIMIT_RPM`) default **120** requests/minute per client IP (`X-Forwarded-For` first hop, else socket). In-memory sliding window. Exceed → `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`. `/health`, `/ready`, `/metrics` are **not** rate-limited (k8s probes / Prometheus). Default `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` includes `Retry-After` and `X-Request-Id` (browser JS can read 429 `Retry-After`). 0 disables the limit. Optional per-tenant budget: `--tenant-budget acme=10,other=5` or env `OTEL_AI_COST_TENANT_BUDGETS` (alias `TENANT_BUDGETS=acme:10`). After `byTenant` rollup, tenants with `usd` > budget appear on JSON as `budgetBreaches: [{tenant,usd,budget}]` (HTTP 200, never 500). Missing tenant budgets → `[]` and no extra webhook. Catch-all tenant `_` is not gated unless `_` is set explicitly. Global `--budget` (totalUsd) is independent. Tenant-breach webhook reuses the budget webhook (`tenant` in JSON body; HMAC still signs raw body; no tokens). **Budget thresholds (not spend):** `GET /v1/budgets` returns `{ok:true, globalUsd: number|null, tenants:{acme:10,…}}` from `--budget` `maxTotalUsd` + `--tenant-budget` / env `OTEL_AI_COST_TENANT_BUDGETS` (alias `TENANT_BUDGETS`). Missing config → `globalUsd: null` and `tenants: {}`. **Not spend** (`budgetBreaches` stays on `/v1/costs`). No secrets. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. **Pricing catalog (rates, not spend):** `GET /v1/models` returns `{ok:true, models:[{id, inputPerMTok, outputPerMTok, …}], defaultModel:null, pack:null}` from the loaded price table (built-in `DEFAULT_PRICES` unless a custom table is loaded). Field names match the table (`inputPerMTok` / `outputPerMTok` on the built-in pack). A single `usdPer1k` is used when that is all an entry has. Cached rates only when present. Empty/default still **200** with the built-in table (not necessarily empty). No secrets. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. **OTLP JSON ingest (live FinOps):** `POST /v1/traces` (alias `POST /v1/otlp/v1/traces`) accepts simplified OTLP `ExportTraceServiceRequest` JSON (`resourceSpans[].scopeSpans[].spans[]`) or E's existing flat `{spans:[]}` / array. Merges into the in-memory store so the next `GET /v1/costs` / HTML / CSV / Markdown / GHA annotations / metrics include them. In-memory cap default **50000** (`--span-max` / `SPAN_MAX`; `0` = unlimited). Over cap, drop oldest; costs recompute from the retained window. `accepted` is parsed count, not how many fit. `--watch` file reload replaces the store then caps. Auth: none by default (local). Optional `INGEST_TOKEN` / `--ingest-token`: when set, require `Authorization: Bearer`; missing/wrong → **401** `{error:"unauthorized"}` (no token in body). Default off so stack-demo never 401s. Bad JSON → **400** `{error:"bad_json"}`. Empty spans → **200** `{ok:true, accepted:0}`. Body over **1048576** bytes → **413** `{error:"payload_too_large"}` before JSON parse (Content-Length early or stream count, B-style). Ingest **is** rate-limited like other app routes. JSON only (no protobuf). **GitHub Actions annotations:** `GET /v1/costs.gha.txt` and `GET /v1/costs?format=gha` (alias `annotations`) return workflow commands (`text/plain`; global `::error title=budget::totalUsd X > budget Y`; each tenant `::error title=tenant/<id>::usd X > budget Y`; no breach → empty 200, no `::error`). Does not require GitHub. **Redacted runtime config (knobs, not spend):** `GET /v1/config` returns `{ok:true, spanCap, spansMax, rateLimit:{perMinute}, cors:{origins}, pack, hasGlobalBudget, tenantBudgetCount, webhooks:{hasUrl,hasSecret}}`. Allowlist only — **never** webhook URL (query tokens), webhook secret, ingest token / API keys, or the price table (that is `GET /v1/models`). Dollar thresholds stay on `GET /v1/budgets` (`hasGlobalBudget` / `tenantBudgetCount` are booleans/counts). Public GET like `/v1/budgets`. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Rate-limited like other app routes. **Span summaries (FinOps debug):** `GET /v1/spans` returns `{ok:true, count, spans:[{id, model, tenant, inputTokens, outputTokens, usd, ts}]}` from the in-memory ring (file-loaded + ingested). Allowlist only — **never** prompt/completion/input/output text, API keys, or Authorization. Cap **100** newest (`truncated: true` when more). `count` is the full retained size. Empty → `{ok:true, count:0, spans:[]}` **200**. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Rate-limited like other app routes. **Tenant inventory (actual spend):** `GET /v1/tenants` returns `{ok:true, count, tenants:[{id, spanCount, usd}]}` from the current in-memory span store (same window as `/v1/spans` / costs). One row per distinct tenant id (missing/empty → `_`). Sort highest `usd` first, then id. Cap **100** (`truncated: true` when more). `count` is the full tenant count. Empty → `{ok:true, count:0, tenants:[]}` **200**. Optional `budgetUsd` on a row only when that tenant has a configured budget (`GET /v1/budgets`.tenants); omit otherwise (do not attach the global budget). Optional `?tenant=` exact filter (unknown → empty 200). Allowlist only — **never** prompts, completions, API keys, Authorization, webhook URL/secret, ingest token, or the full price catalog. Public GET like `/v1/spans` / `/v1/budgets`. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Rate-limited like other app routes.

tags.name: health
tags.description: Liveness (GET /health always 200; shuttingDown true while draining) and readiness (GET /ready 200 when healthy, 503 shutting_down while draining)

tags.name: report
tags.description: HTML+SVG cost report, structured JSON (UTC daily when groupBy=day), finance CSV (`date,model,spanCount,usd,tenant` — tenant last), and FinOps Markdown (`# otel-ai-cost` + by-model / by-tenant tables), and GitHub Actions `::error` annotations (`GET /v1/costs.gha.txt` / `?format=gha`; empty when no breach); configured thresholds `GET /v1/budgets` (`globalUsd` + `tenants`, not spend); pricing catalog `GET /v1/models` (`models` rates, not spend); redacted runtime knobs `GET /v1/config` (`spanCap` / CORS / rate-limit / webhook booleans; not spend); span summaries `GET /v1/spans` (`listSpans`; allowlist id/model/tenant/tokens/usd/ts; no prompts/secrets; cap 100 newest); tenant inventory `GET /v1/tenants` (`listTenants`; `{id, spanCount, usd}` + optional `budgetUsd`; no prompts/secrets; cap 100)

tags.name: ingest
tags.description: OTLP JSON trace ingest (POST /v1/traces). Live FinOps path; in-memory span cap; file --watch replaces the store then caps.

tags.name: config
tags.description: Redacted public runtime config (GET /v1/config). Allowlist only — never secrets.

get.description: Liveness plus snapshot `spanCount` and `totalUsd`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied` (see info). Not rate-limited.

200.description: Server is up (cost snapshot at process start)

get.description: Readiness. **200** `{ok:true, service}` plus snapshot `spanCount` and `totalUsd` (same as `/health`) when healthy. On SIGTERM/SIGINT, **503** `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` (liveness `GET /health` stays 200 with `shuttingDown: true`). Stateless cost snapshot — no circuit/queue. Compose/stack-demo healthchecks stay on `/health`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Not rate-limited.

200.description: Ready (same snapshot fields as GET /health). 200 when healthy; 503 `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT.

503.description: Not ready: process is shutting down after SIGTERM/SIGINT. `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}`. GET /health stays 200 with `shuttingDown: true` while draining.

get.description: Self-contained HTML (inline CSS, pure-SVG byModel chart, UTC daily section when groupBy=day). No external script/CDN. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

Serve default is UTC daily rollup (`groupBy=day`) including `totalUsd` and `days[]`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`. Includes `byTenant` and `budgetBreaches` (empty array when no `--tenant-budget` / env).

Daily-by-model+tenant totals as CSV with header `date,model,spanCount,usd,tenant` (`tenant` last so `date,model,spanCount,usd` greps still match) plus a TOTAL row. Same cost model as `/report.json` (`day` → `date`, per-model `spanCount`, `usd`). Missing/empty span attr `tenant` → `_`. Empty spans → header-only **200**. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Access-logged (not skipped like `/metrics`). Alias: `GET /v1/costs?format=csv`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

200.description: CSV cost snapshot (header + day/model rows + TOTAL; header only when empty)

get.description: GitHub-flavored Markdown for Slack / email / GitHub Actions `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`. Shape: `# otel-ai-cost`, `**totalUsd:**` / `**spans:**`, `## by model` table (`model | usd | spans`), `## by tenant` table (`tenant | usd | spans`). `|` in cells is escaped. Empty spans → heading + zeros + table headers (no data rows), **200**. Same cost model as `/report.json`. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Access-logged (not skipped like `/metrics`). Alias: `GET /v1/costs?format=md`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

200.description: Markdown cost snapshot (heading + totals + by-model / by-tenant tables; heading + zeros when empty)

text/markdown.example:
# otel-ai-cost
**totalUsd:** 0.000450  **spans:** 1
## by model
| model | usd | spans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| gpt-4o-mini | 0.000450 | 1 |
## by tenant
| tenant | usd | spans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| acme | 0.000450 | 1 |

get.summary: GitHub Actions annotations alias (same as GET /v1/costs?format=gha)
get.description: Same body as `GET /v1/costs?format=gha` (workflow commands: global `::error title=budget::totalUsd X > budget Y` when `--budget` maxTotalUsd is exceeded; each tenant `::error title=tenant/<id>::usd X > budget Y` from `budgetBreaches`; no breach → empty body 200, no `::error`). Content-Type `text/plain`. Does not require GitHub. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

200.description: GHA workflow commands (empty body is still 200)

get.description: Versioned cost snapshot. Query `format=json` (default) is the same DailyReport body as `GET /report.json`. `format=csv` is the same `text/csv` body as `GET /v1/costs.csv`. `format=md` is the same `text/markdown` body as `GET /v1/costs.md`. `format=gha` (alias `annotations`) is GitHub Actions workflow commands (`text/plain`; same as `GET /v1/costs.gha.txt`; global `::error title=budget::totalUsd X > budget Y`; tenant `::error title=tenant/<id>::usd X > budget Y`; no breach → empty 200). Unknown format → **400** `{error:"bad_format"}`. Existing `/report.json` clients are unchanged. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`. JSON includes `budgetBreaches` (same as `/report.json`).

200.description: Cost snapshot in the requested format

text/markdown.example:
# otel-ai-cost
**totalUsd:** 0.000450  **spans:** 1
## by model
| model | usd | spans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| gpt-4o-mini | 0.000450 | 1 |
## by tenant
| tenant | usd | spans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| acme | 0.000450 | 1 |

get.description: Returns configured global + tenant budget **thresholds**, not spend. `{ok:true, globalUsd: number|null, tenants:{acme:10,…}}`. `globalUsd` is `--budget` policy `maxTotalUsd` (missing/empty → `null`). `tenants` is `--tenant-budget` / env `OTEL_AI_COST_TENANT_BUDGETS` (alias `TENANT_BUDGETS`) map (missing → `{}`). Never includes spend, `budgetBreaches`, webhook secrets, or ingest tokens. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

200.description: Configured thresholds. Missing config → `globalUsd: null` and `tenants: {}`.

get.description: Returns the loaded price table as a catalog (rates, not spend). `{ok:true, models:[{id, inputPerMTok, outputPerMTok, …}], defaultModel:null, pack:null}`. Built-in table is `DEFAULT_PRICES` (`gpt-4o`, `gpt-4o-mini`, `claude-sonnet` with `inputPerMTok` / `outputPerMTok`). Field names match the table — do not invent rates. A single `usdPer1k` is used when that is all an entry has. Cached rates only when present. Empty/default still **200** with the built-in table (not necessarily empty). Never includes spend, webhook secrets, or ingest tokens. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

200.description: Pricing catalog from the loaded table. Default built-in pack is non-empty.

get.description: Allowlisted summaries of recent ingested / file-loaded spans: `{ok, count, spans:[{id, model, tenant, inputTokens, outputTokens, usd, ts}]}`. Field names match `spanCost` / OTel attrs (`gen_ai.request.model`, `tenant`, `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens` / `output_tokens`, `spanId`/`id`, `timestamp`/`startTimeUnixNano`). **Never** includes prompt/completion/input/output text, API keys, or Authorization. Newest first. Cap **100**; `count` is the full retained ring size; `truncated: true` when more (omitted otherwise). Empty store → **200** `{ok:true, count:0, spans:[]}`. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`.

200.description: Span summaries (empty list when the store has no spans)

get.description: Redacted per-tenant spend inventory from the current in-memory span store (same window as `/v1/spans` / costs): `{ok, count, tenants:[{id, spanCount, usd}]}`. One row per distinct tenant id. Missing/empty span attr `tenant` → `_`. `usd` uses the same rounding as report totals. Sort highest `usd` first, then id. Cap **100**; `count` is the full tenant count; `truncated: true` when more (omitted otherwise). Empty store → **200** `{ok:true, count:0, tenants:[]}`. Optional `budgetUsd` only when that tenant has a configured budget (`GET /v1/budgets`.tenants); omit the field otherwise. Do not attach the global budget. Optional `?tenant=` exact filter (unknown id → empty 200). **Never** includes prompt/completion/input/output text, API keys, Authorization, webhook URL/secret, ingest token, or the price catalog. Public GET like `/v1/spans` / `/v1/budgets` (no admin token). CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`.

200.description: Tenant spend rollup (empty list when the store has no spans or the filter matches none)

post.description: Live FinOps ingest. `Content-Type: application/json`. Accepts simplified OTLP `ExportTraceServiceRequest` (`resourceSpans[].scopeSpans[].spans[]` with attributes `gen_ai.request.model` / `tenant` already understood by cost.js) or a flat `spans` array. Merges into the in-memory snapshot used by `/`, `/report.json`, `/v1/costs`, `/v1/costs.csv`, `/v1/costs.md, `/v1/costs.gha.txt``, `/metrics`, `/health`, `/ready`. `--watch` still reloads the `--in` file. Auth none by default; when `INGEST_TOKEN` / `--ingest-token` is set, require `Authorization: Bearer`. Missing/wrong → **401**. Bad JSON → **400**. Empty spans → **200** `{ok:true, accepted:0}`. Over 1 MiB → **413** `payload_too_large`. Rate-limited like other app routes (`/health` `/ready` `/metrics` still skipped). Alias: `POST /v1/otlp/v1/traces`. JSON only — no protobuf.
Alias of `POST /v1/traces`. Same body, auth, rate limit, and merge behavior.

get.description: Prometheus text exposition of the cost snapshot (computed once at process start). Gauges: `otel_ai_cost_total_usd`, `otel_ai_cost_by_model_usd{model}`. Counter: `otel_ai_cost_span_count`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Matching GET includes ACAO (same as other GET). Not rate-limited.

text/plain.example:
# TYPE otel_ai_cost_total_usd gauge
otel_ai_cost_total_usd 0.013
# TYPE otel_ai_cost_by_model_usd gauge
otel_ai_cost_by_model_usd{model="gpt-4o"} 0.01
# TYPE otel_ai_cost_span_count counter
otel_ai_cost_span_count 6

get.description: File-backed spec from `openapi/cost.openapi.json`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

500.description: Spec file missing or invalid JSON

get.description: Public snapshot of non-secret runtime **knobs** (not spend). Same auth as `GET /v1/budgets` (no token). Allowlist only: `spanCap` / `spansMax` (`--span-max` / `SPAN_MAX`, default 50000; 0 = unlimited), `rateLimit.perMinute` (null if unlimited), `cors.origins`, `pack` name or null, `hasGlobalBudget` (boolean — dollar amount stays on `/v1/budgets`), `tenantBudgetCount`, `webhooks.hasUrl` / `webhooks.hasSecret` (booleans — **never** the webhook URL, which may contain query tokens, and **never** the secret). **Forbidden:** webhook URL, webhook secret, ingest token, API keys, price table dump (see `GET /v1/models`). CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Rate-limited like `/v1/budgets` (not a probe path).

AccessControlAllowOrigin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches `--cors-origins` / `OTEL_AI_COST_CORS_ORIGINS` (or `*` when configured). Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

XRequestId.description: Echo of incoming `X-Request-Id`, or a generated UUID when the request header is omitted/empty. Present on every response (incl 4xx / OPTIONS).

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a rate-limited request.

shuttingDown.description: Present and true while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT. Omitted otherwise so stack-demo /health is unchanged.

tenant.description: Span attribute `tenant` when present on internal rows. Serialized daily rows omit this; use `byTenant`.

DailyReport.description: UTC daily cost rollup (serve default `--group-by day`). Includes `byTenant` from span attr `tenant` (missing/empty → `_`). `budgetBreaches` lists tenants whose `usd` exceeded `--tenant-budget` / `OTEL_AI_COST_TENANT_BUDGETS` (empty when unset). Global `--budget` totalUsd is independent.

byTenant.description: Cost rollup by span attribute `tenant`. Missing/empty → `_`.

budgetBreaches.description: Per-tenant budget breaches. Empty when no tenant budgets configured. HTTP never 500 for missing tenant budgets.

CorsConfig.description: Optional CORS. Default omitted or empty origins = no extra CORS headers (deny). `origins` may be `["*"]` (any Origin) or an explicit list. When enabled with an explicit list, OPTIONS preflight for a non-listed Origin returns **403** `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}`; allowed Origin → **204** with ACAO/ACAM/ACAH. Matching GET get Access-Control-Allow-Origin. local-mvp uses `["http://localhost:3000"]`. Default `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` includes `Retry-After` and `X-Request-Id`.

origins.description: `["*"]` or explicit origins. Empty/omitted disables CORS.

Ready.description: GET /ready body. 200 `{ok:true, service}` plus the same snapshot fields as GET /health when healthy. 503 `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT. Snapshot/stateless — no circuit or queue. Compose/stack-demo healthchecks stay on `/health`.

BudgetBreach.description: Per-tenant budget breach (`usd` > configured budget). `_` only appears when `_` was set explicitly.

OtlpIngestRequest.description: Simplified OTLP ExportTraceServiceRequest JSON, or E's existing `{spans:[]}` / array. Attributes may be a map or OTLP KeyValue list.

Budgets.description: Configured budget thresholds (not spend). `globalUsd` is `--budget` `maxTotalUsd`. `tenants` maps tenant id → USD threshold from `--tenant-budget`. Missing → `null` / `{}`. No secrets.

tenants.description: Per-tenant USD thresholds (`--tenant-budget` / `OTEL_AI_COST_TENANT_BUDGETS`). Empty object when none configured.

ModelRate.description: One model's rates from the loaded price table. Field names match the table (`inputPerMTok` / `outputPerMTok` on the built-in pack). A single `usdPer1k` is used when that is all the entry has. Cached rates only when present. No invented rates. No secrets.

cachedPerMTok.description: USD per 1M cached tokens when the table has it.

usdPer1kInput.description: Present only when the loaded table uses this key.

usdPer1kOutput.description: Present only when the loaded table uses this key.

usdPer1kCached.description: Present only when the loaded table uses this key.

usdPer1k.description: Present when a model only has a single usdPer1k rate.

Models.description: Pricing catalog (rates, not spend). `models` is the loaded price table. `defaultModel` / `pack` are null unless a named pack or default model is configured. No secrets.

defaultModel.description: Default model id when configured; otherwise null.

pack.description: Named price pack when configured; otherwise null (built-in table).

RuntimeConfig.description: Public redacted runtime config (GET /v1/config). Allowlist only — never webhook URL, webhook secret, ingest token, API keys, or the price table. Knobs, not spend (dollar thresholds stay on GET /v1/budgets; rates stay on GET /v1/models). Mirrors B GET /admin/config and C/F GET /v1/config; E has no admin token on this GET.

origins.description: Allowed Origins (`["*"]` = any). Empty = CORS disabled.

pack.description: Named policy/price pack when configured; otherwise null.

hasGlobalBudget.description: True when `--budget` `maxTotalUsd` is set. Dollar amount stays on GET /v1/budgets.

tenantBudgetCount.description: Number of `--tenant-budget` entries. Thresholds stay on GET /v1/budgets.

webhooks.description: Outbound budget-breach webhook presence. Booleans only — never the URL (query tokens) or secret.

hasUrl.description: True when `--webhook-url` / `OTEL_AI_COST_WEBHOOK_URL` is set. The URL itself is never returned.

hasSecret.description: True when `--webhook-secret` / `OTEL_AI_COST_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is set. The secret itself is never returned.

SpanSummary.description: Allowlisted span summary (GET /v1/spans). Never prompt/completion/input/output text, API keys, or Authorization.

id.description: OTLP `spanId` or `id` when present; otherwise a stable `s{index}` fallback.

usd.description: Estimated USD from the loaded price table (same as spanCost.usd).

ts.description: ISO-8601 from `timestamp` / `startTimeUnixNano` (same fields as spanUtcDay). Missing → null.

SpanList.description: Recent span summaries (GET /v1/spans). Empty store is still 200 with count 0. `count` is the full retained ring size; the array is capped at 100 newest.

count.description: Full retained size of the in-memory span ring (not the capped array length).

truncated.description: True when more than 100 spans are retained (list capped at 100 newest). Omitted when not truncated.

TenantSpend.description: Per-tenant spend row (GET /v1/tenants). Never prompt/completion/input/output text, API keys, or Authorization.

spanCount.description: Number of spans attributed to this tenant.

usd.description: Estimated USD (same rounding as report / `byTenant` totals).

budgetUsd.description: Configured tenant budget when set (`GET /v1/budgets`.tenants). Omitted when no tenant budget. Not the global budget.

TenantList.description: Per-tenant spend inventory (GET /v1/tenants). Empty store is still 200 with count 0. `count` is the full tenant count; the array is capped at 100.

count.description: Full distinct-tenant count (not the capped array length).

truncated.description: True when more than 100 tenants are present (list capped at 100). Omitted when not truncated.

CorsDenied.description: CORS preflight (OPTIONS) for an Origin not in `--cors-origins` / `OTEL_AI_COST_CORS_ORIGINS`. Body `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}`. No `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`. Does not apply when CORS is disabled (then OPTIONS is 404 without ACAO). GET from a disallowed Origin still execute (e.g. 200) but omit ACAO.

RateLimited.description: Sliding-window rate limit exceeded (client IP, X-Forwarded-For first hop). Retry after `Retry-After` seconds. `/health`, `/ready`, `/metrics` are not rate-limited.

Unauthorized.description: Ingest token is configured (`INGEST_TOKEN` / `--ingest-token`) but `Authorization: Bearer` is missing or does not match. Body `{error:"unauthorized"}` — never echoes the token. Default token unset → this 401 is not returned.

PayloadTooLarge.description: POST body larger than 1048576 bytes (B-style cap). Rejected before JSON parse via Content-Length or stream count. `{error:"payload_too_large"}`.

XRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
XRequestId.description: Optional correlation id. Echoed on every response as `X-Request-Id`. If omitted/empty, the server generates a UUID (max 128 chars; CR/LF stripped).

CostFormat.name: format
CostFormat.description: Export format. `json` (default) = DailyReport JSON (same as `/report.json`). `csv` = finance CSV (`date,model,spanCount,usd,tenant`, same as `/v1/costs.csv`). `md` = FinOps Markdown (same as `/v1/costs.md`; Slack / email / `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`). `gha` = GitHub Actions workflow commands (`text/plain`; alias `annotations`; path alias `GET /v1/costs.gha.txt`; `::error title=budget` / `::error title=tenant/<id>`; no breach → empty).

TenantFilter.name: tenant
TenantFilter.description: Exact tenant id filter (one id). Unknown → **200** `{ok:true, count:0, tenants:[]}`.

IngestBearer.description: Optional ingest token. Required only when INGEST_TOKEN / --ingest-token is set. Default off (local / stack-demo).
